newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures end sharply higher, off high.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures end sharply higher, off high.

text.p: Jan 17 - U.S. stock index futures ended sharply higher, off peaks. March S&Ps backed off from new all-time high at 781.70 put in on some retail buying, local shortcovering. Some said stocks worked upward as talk spread of Microsoft "whisper" Q2 earnings estimate of $0.53-$0.55 vs First Call consensus of $0.51. CME stock index futures open normal hours Jan 20.
